# user-photo API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Retrieve selected Microsoft Graph profile-photo bytes through a caller-owned client.

## SPFxUserPhotoService

Explicit profile-photo retrieval through a caller-owned Graph client. Does not create or revoke object URLs.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { SPFxUserPhotoService, createSPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const photos: SPFxUserPhotoService = createSPFxUserPhotoService(graphClient);
  const blob = await photos.getPhotoBlob();
}
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxUserPhotoService.getPhotoBlob` | `(options?: SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions \| undefined) => Promise<Blob>` | Required | — | Fetches a profile photo. |

#### SPFxUserPhotoService.getPhotoBlob (2)

##### Throws

- Graph failures, including missing photos and insufficient permissions.

##### Parameters

- `options`: Omitted targets /me at 240x240; userId takes precedence over email. Identifiers are interpolated without encoding.

##### Returns

Graph response as a Blob.

## SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions

User and size selection for a Graph photo. If neither identifier is supplied, targets /me.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const options: SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions = { email: 'user@contoso.com', size: '96x96' };
```

### Members (2)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions.email` | `string \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | — | User email or UPN, used when userId is absent/empty. Omitted/empty targets /me when there is no userId. |
| `SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions.size` | `SPFxUserPhotoServiceSize \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | '240x240' | Requested photo dimensions; omitted or undefined uses 240x240. |
| `SPFxUserPhotoServiceOptions.userId` | `string \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | — | Graph user/object ID; takes precedence over email when nonempty. Omitted/empty uses email, then /me. |

## createSPFxUserPhotoService

Creates profile-photo operations without React state or provider access.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import { createSPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createSPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Use when

- You need profile-photo bytes through a caller-owned Graph client without React or object-URL lifetime management.

### Examples (4)

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { createSPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const photos = createSPFxUserPhotoService(graphClient);
  const blob = await photos.getPhotoBlob({ email: 'user@contoso.com' });
}
```

#### Read own and selected-user photo blobs

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';

import { createSPFxUserPhotoService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const photos = createSPFxUserPhotoService(graphClient);
  const ownPhoto = await photos.getPhotoBlob();
  const selected = await photos.getPhotoBlob({ email: 'user@contoso.com', size: '96x96' });
}
```

### Signatures (2)

```ts
(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3): SPFxUserPhotoService
```

#### Parameters (3)

- `graphClient`: Initialized Graph client with the required permissions.

#### Returns (3)

Photo retrieval methods; construction performs no request.
